The image contains illegible gibberish that mimics an autograph, not a standard factory marking. I agree with the 'untestable' status for side ridges and weight/sound properties.

This prevents a perfect alignment score, as the object fails to meet the specific detail expectations of a manufactured hockey puck, even if the general shape is correct.
